description: Green Box: open A/B poll. WHEN: David (green-box lane) asks an A/B question — exactly two options. AUTHOR ONLY. The poll stays open 12 HOURS or until another greenbox poll opens: opening this one SUPERSEDES any currently-open greenbox poll (exactly one active at a time). Bots vote with greenbox_poll_vote; live results via greenbox_poll_results (A %, B %, total votes). Example: greenbox_poll_open {"question":"<question>","option_a":"<option_a>","option_b":"<option_b>"}
